== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Karosha refers to both a planet and its associated empire, which is currently experiencing an internal civil war. The [[Karoshan Empire]] includes the [[Visiria system]] and several other territories, forming a powerful alliance. The political landscape is defined by conflict between the rightful ruler, [[Queen Shyrax]] III, and a usurper. The royal family has historically maintained connections with the planet's [[World Spirit]], and the ruling class includes figures such as [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]]. The [[Karoshan people]] are physically distinct from humans, possessing thicker bronze-toned skin and glowing hair that comes in various colors like pink, green, gold, or bronze. Their hair-cables hold significant traditional value and are often left exposed from their helmets. While they can appear stoic or difficult for humans to read, they are considered superior to humanity in many ways. They are a prolific species with large families, particularly among the nobility. Technologically and militarily, Karosha is highly advanced. Their spacecraft are characterized by a blocky, black aesthetic and are heavily armed; their fleet ranges from standard cruisers equipped with starfighters to massive six-mile-long dreadnoughts. They also utilize moon-sized space colonies and specialized research outposts. [[Karoshan]] society integrates various disciplines, including alchemy and advanced biological engineering involving lab-grown organic materials. Their military reputation is fearsome, often serving as cautionary tales among other galactic soldiers.}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Karosha is a planet governed by the rule of a [[Queen]]. This sovereign ruler is identified as [[Shyrax the Third]]. == The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Karosha is a significant location characterized by its royal [[throne]] and the presence of laboratories belonging to the [[King Regent]]. The realm serves as the site from which [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] was previously exiled. Within its borders, the former [[Queen]] remains a suspect in the kidnapping of [[Doctor Nova]]. Furthermore, the Alliance mandates that all visitors to Karosha must arrive in person.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Karosha is a major system that requires reclamation and serves as the realm of [[Queen Shyrax]]. Although Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax's people have been away from the location for nearly two years, any interactions with the Visirian planetary government are reported to Karosha within an hour. Following the departure of [[The Perfected|the Perfected]], the system remains a significant territory that the [[Swarm-Queen]] might potentially feed on.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Ruled by [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]], Karosha is a location that maintains a high level of respect for the practice of alchemy. The territory serves as the home to both a [[Rebel Queen]] and [[Prince Veshran]], and it is characterized by the presence of a royal house. Both [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] and King Regent{{!}}King Regent Felrex maintain royal palaces within its borders. Ultimately, Karosha exists as an entity that may be impacted by [[Union]] business.}}
